'''Cassius''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he, along with [[Varek]], [[Eli]] and [[Ashara Zavros]], was brought to [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to train under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Ryen]] and [[Ocera]], whose philosophy was that Padawans best learned the travails of using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] through firsthand experience of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cassius appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Taris.
